proposal.summary: Eclipse Mosquitto broker 1.3.2 through 2.x before 2.0.16 has a remotely-triggerable memory leak when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs and does not respond to PUBREC, due to mishandling of EAGAIN from libc send.
proposal.cwe_quote: has a memory leak that can be abused remotely when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs, and fails to respond to PUBREC commands.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Attempt to reproduce by connecting a client and sending a sustained stream of QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs while not responding to PUBREC; monitor broker memory to confirm leak and collect crash/OOM conditions. Prepare a patch that fixes handling of EAGAIN from send and add a regression test.

evidence_quotes.quote: The broker in Eclipse Mosquitto 1.3.2 through 2.x before 2.0.16
has a memory leak that can be abused remotely when a client sends many QoS 2 messages with duplicate message IDs, and fails to respond to PUBREC commands.
This occurs because of mishandling of EAGAIN from the libc send function.
